roles.label: Platform Roles
roles.sub: Every role is purpose-built with specific tools, access levels, and incentives aligned to the platform's business logic.

ai.label: AI Toolkit
ai.desc: Founders enter unstructured data. Our AI engine converts it into a structured, investment-ready profile that matches investor expectations — automatically.
ai.note: No pitch deck design needed. The system handles structure, scoring, and delivery to investors — you focus on building.
ai.step1Desc: Founders submit raw data: team, product, market, traction, and funding needs.
ai.step2Desc: Our AI processes and restructures the data into a standardized, investor-ready profile format.
ai.step3Desc: A structured, scored profile is generated — ready for investor review and matching.
ai.step4Desc: Investors receive filtered, ranked deal flow — matched to their industry and stage preferences.

matching.label: Matching Engine
matching.sub: The algorithm does the heavy lifting. Connections are made based on data — not personal preference or admin bottlenecks.
matching.rule1Desc: Startup sector compared against mentor and investor domain expertise.
matching.rule2Desc: Seed, Series A, B — each stage matched to appropriate investor profiles.
matching.rule3Desc: The engine runs autonomously. Admin oversight reserved for escalations only.
matching.adminNote: Admin role: Monitoring, dispute resolution, manual override only. The algorithm is the primary driver of connections.

credibility.label: Trust Infrastructure
credibility.sub: Static rankings are replaced by a live credibility system — evolving with every interaction, session, and outcome on the platform.
credibility.sig1Desc: Every completed session is reviewed. Peer validation builds long-term trust.
credibility.sig2Desc: Verified mentoring activity. Sessions are tracked and confirmed on-platform.
credibility.sig3Desc: Funding events and successful partnerships contribute the most to long-term score.

business.label: Business Model
business.sub: We only earn when you succeed. The platform is structured to align our incentives with yours.
business.freeDesc: Explore the ecosystem, build your profile, and start connecting.
business.freeF4: Submit to AI pitch builder (1 profile)
business.premDesc: Unlock full platform capabilities for serious ecosystem players.
business.feeDesc: A one-time 10% fee applies only after capital is formally disbursed to the startup. No upfront cost, no hidden charges. You pay only when you raise.

how.label: How It Works
how.title: Three Steps to Launch
how.sub: From registration to your first connection — the platform guides you every step of the way.
how.step1Desc: Create a founder profile that showcases your vision, team, and traction. Let your story speak for itself.
how.step2Desc: Our AI engine matches you with relevant mentors and investors based on your industry, stage, and goals.
how.step3Desc: Close your funding round. A 10% success fee applies only after capital is disbursed — aligned with your success.
